body:
Review pass 26. Files 12 min cold so I reviewed Epic 7 properly. Two things: I have to correct my own earlier reference, and there is an acceptance gap worth catching before closure.

1. I WAS INCOMPLETE. My pass-19 reference concluded "no detectable leakage at any shrinkage level". I only tested the NULL. Under SIGNAL the two policies differ materially. Full criterion-3 quantities, paired on identical noise draws, reps=400, shrinkage=0.05, n=48, p=12, R=4:

  NULL (target 0.000000)
    train-only  mean +0.000278  var 1.222e-04  RMSE 0.011042  MCse 0.000553
    all-runs    mean +0.000278  var 9.859e-05  RMSE 0.009921  MCse 0.000496
    paired diff mean -0.000000  z -0.00   90% CI [-0.000232, +0.000231]

  SIGNAL (target 0.033992)
    train-only  mean +0.035107  bias_vs_pop +0.001115  bias_vs_cond +0.002993  var 3.979e-04  RMSE 0.019953
    all-runs    mean +0.033078  bias_vs_pop -0.000914  bias_vs_cond +0.000965  var 3.331e-04  RMSE 0.018252
    paired diff mean -0.002028  MCse 0.000207  z -9.81  90% CI [-0.002369, -0.001688]

2. THE MECHANISM IS LEARNER QUALITY, NOT LEAKAGE - which is exactly the distinction your criterion 5 asks for. With R=4, excluding both evaluated runs leaves training-only with TWO runs of residuals while all-runs uses FOUR. A noisier Sigma_hat inverts to a systematically larger K, inflating the estimate - hence train-only sitting high. Under the null this cannot show, since delta_a and delta_b are independent of Sigma_hat. The bias_vs_cond column against the TRUE metric confirms it: 0.0030 vs 0.0010, about 3x.

To separate provenance from data volume, compare all-runs against a training-only policy MATCHED on number of training runs (e.g. R=6 with 4 training runs in both arms). What survives is provenance; what disappears is learner quality.

3. ACCEPTANCE GAP. Your test file is 5 blocks, 34 expectations, all passing, all structural. Against the seven criteria: three MET (same plan/different identities, undeclared access fails early, no CI until calibration), one PARTIAL (shrinkage in provenance but not in uncertainty analysis), three NOT MET (paired simulations reporting bias/variance/RMSE/MC uncertainty; distinguishing evaluator correctness from learner quality; material difference becomes a durable evidence report). grep for replicate/margin/colMeans/seed returns nothing, so there is no simulation machinery here yet.

That last criterion is now live rather than hypothetical, since there IS a material difference. Closing on structural tests alone would record that the policies share execution and retain identity, while leaving unstated that they disagree under signal and why. Epic 0A closing without its required subtraction receipt is the precedent worth not repeating. Numbers above are ready to lift.
